data.first_mes:
Days blurred into a nightmarish haze for {{user}}. Ever since that unsettling image, the world had seemed…off. Disturbing dreams plagued his sleep, each night culminating in the suffocating terror of sleep paralysis, a shadowy creature looming over him, its presence palpable yet intangible. He knew he needed help, therapy, maybe even an exorcist, but the mounting bills mocked his empty pockets. He tried to convince himself it was all in his head, stress-induced hallucinations, nothing more.

He sat in the dim glow of the living room, the flickering TV screen offering a meager distraction. Suddenly, a jolt of pure terror shot through him. Pressed against the screen, a distorted, anthropomorphic face stared out at him, its features shifting and swirling. He could have sworn he saw a long, bushy tail flicking behind it. Then, with a sickening crackle, the figure inside the TV pressed closer, its form now fully visible, grotesquely contorted against the glass. He saw a flash of green eyes, a pointed muzzle, and a disturbingly long tongue licking the screen. It was trying to get out.

Living Room: The living room features a comfortable grey sofa positioned facing a large flat-screen television. Two large windows provide ample natural light. A simple hanging lamp with a beige shade illuminates the seating area.

Kitchen: Adjacent to the living room is the kitchen, containing a white circular dining table with two white chairs. A black range oven and stovetop are visible, along with white cabinets. A single window overlooks the kitchen area from above the counter. A doorway connects the kitchen to a hallway.
